credit_policy: Each failed witness remains a retained operational negative with zero validation or completion credit. A bounded recovery never erases the failure.

records.failed_witness: The first requested 418-line final activation-baton interval exceeded its output envelope and truncated before the exact EOF boundary could be attributed.
records.recovery: Reread the affected interval as independent 200-line and 218-line windows, then request an empty post-EOF interval.
records.passing_witness: All 3218 content lines and 35580 words were read through true EOF with the expected byte count and SHA-256.
records.recurrence_guard: Use independent windows no larger than 200 lines for long committed activations and require an empty post-EOF read.
records.rollback: The truncated read changed no state and earned zero activation-read credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Do not infer EOF from a display limit or a nominal final interval.

records.failed_witness: A broad immutable-tree inventory for skill names exceeded the output envelope and truncated before the required skill set could be attributed.
records.recovery: Probe each required skill by exact local name and read every selected SKILL.md and directly required schema through EOF.
records.passing_witness: All mandated skills and referenced schemas were read completely, and the first eleven committed skill hashes matched exactly.
records.recurrence_guard: Resolve skill names exactly before reading; never dump an entire skill tree into one display.
records.rollback: The broad read changed no skill or repository state and earned zero inventory credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Keep skill discovery exact-name and hash-bound.

records.failed_witness: A full authorization current-state JSON display truncated even though a separate post-EOF scalar was visible, so the file was not yet completely attributable.
records.recovery: Read the 1487-line authorization state in four bounded windows and then verify a zero-line post-EOF window.
records.passing_witness: The complete authorization state and schema were read through EOF and the local validator reported a valid 13-permission state with 43 inherited operational negatives.
records.recurrence_guard: Treat a post-EOF scalar as insufficient when the preceding content display truncates.
records.rollback: The truncated display changed no authorization state and earned zero complete-read credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Bind completeness to every content window plus an empty post-EOF read.

records.failed_witness: An overbroad pretty projection of the source-to-evidence manifest truncated before its complete entry set could be attributed.
records.recovery: Inspect scalar commitments and independently recompute the exact immutable Git-object manifest, path audit, canonical commitment, and Merkle root.
records.passing_witness: The recomputed 71-entry source-to-evidence and 93-entry source-to-final manifests matched their committed contracts with zero path-audit issue.
records.recurrence_guard: Project manifest scalars first and recompute exact Git-object commitments without printing every entry.
records.rollback: The display-only failure changed no Git object or manifest and earned zero manifest credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Prefer commitment equality over broad entry dumps.

records.failed_witness: A sparse-receipt lookup guessed the file at the phase root instead of its committed x1 child and returned a path-not-found error.
records.recovery: Use an exact phase-scoped Git tree query to locate the receipt at x1/sparse-lane-receipt.json.
records.passing_witness: The exact committed receipt path was located without enumerating sibling lanes.
records.recurrence_guard: Resolve phase artifact paths from the exact Git tree before filesystem reads.
records.rollback: The failed literal read changed no filesystem or Git state and earned zero receipt credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Do not infer x1 receipt placement from a shortened artifact name.

records.failed_witness: The first corrected sparse-receipt projection guessed a nonexistent sparse_patterns property and returned null.
records.recovery: Read the small exact receipt completely and use its actual patterns property.
records.passing_witness: All six sparse patterns and their sparse-before-materialization contract were recovered exactly.
records.recurrence_guard: Inspect real JSON keys before projecting receipt fields.
records.rollback: The null projection changed no state and earned zero sparse-pattern credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Treat schema-key guesses as failed witnesses, even when the file itself is correct.

records.failed_witness: The combined worktree-add, sparse-init, sparse-set, index-materialization, and receipt projection exceeded its output window after only the initial Preparing worktree line.
records.recovery: Do not replay the combined mutation; inspect the exact target path, local branch, head, sparse configuration, materialized files, and status read-only.
records.passing_witness: The exact Auren branch and worktree existed at the immutable source, all six sparse rules were active, exactly four initial files were materialized, and the index was clean.
records.recurrence_guard: Separate bounded setup mutations from their read-only attribution receipt when the host output window is tight.
records.rollback: No recovery mutation was needed; the incomplete wrapper receipt remains a zero-credit operational failure.
records.sibling_recommendation: Inspect actual state before retrying a timed-out setup wrapper.

records.failed_witness: The first strict-JSON validation probe guessed a nonexistent strict_load_json file helper and failed import before reading any x1 file.
records.recovery: Inspect the exact toolkit function names and invoke strict_json_loads on each file's immutable bytes.
records.passing_witness: All eight x1 JSON files parsed under duplicate-key refusal with zero duplicate keys.
records.recurrence_guard: Resolve the exact exported helper name before composing a strict-parser probe.
records.rollback: The import failure changed no file or Git state and earned zero strict-JSON credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Use the toolkit's byte-level strict parser unless a file wrapper is verified to exist.
